Subscribe to real-time events for clusters, projects, workloads, and addons.

This endpoint uses Server-Sent Events (SSE) to push real-time updates to clients.
Events include lifecycle changes, status updates, and health monitoring.

## Event Types
- Cluster events: connected, disconnected, heartbeat, status_update
- Project events: create, update, delete, status_update
- Workload events: deploy, scale, restart, delete, rollback, status_update
- Addon events: install, upgrade, uninstall, status_update
